title: Structured RCA report v1
description: Structured output of one investigation. Facts must cite stored evidence; anything without evidence belongs in hypotheses. `inconclusive` is a valid, expected result when evidence is missing or the budget is exhausted. The report never contains hidden reasoning or credentials.

investigation_id.description: Central investigation id this report belongs to.

status.description: Confidence class, not a calibrated probability. Use inconclusive when the evidence or budget is insufficient.

summary.description: Short operator-facing summary. Must not state an unsupported claim as fact.

root_cause_candidates.description: Ranked candidate root causes. Empty when status is inconclusive/unknown.

fault_type.description: Fault class, aligned with the fault catalogue where possible (e.g. cpu_saturation, memory_pressure).

rank.description: 1 = most likely. Ties are allowed only with an explicit reason in limitations.

evidence_ids.description: Evidence supporting this candidate. A candidate without evidence must be a hypothesis instead.

confirmed_facts.description: Statements promoted to fact because they cite at least one stored evidence item.

evidence_ids.description: Stored evidence references; empty is invalid.

hypotheses.description: Unconfirmed explanations, kept separate from facts.

alternative_hypotheses.description: Alternatives that were considered and not ruled out.

missing_evidence.description: What would be needed to confirm or eliminate the candidates.

proposed_action.description: Optional proposal. Only a catalogue action id is allowed; the Remediation Manager re-validates target, parameters, level and approval.

limitations.description: Known limits of this investigation (single node, missing metrics, time budget, ...).
